newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brash wants more realistic view of NZ asset risk.
newsitem.headline: Brash wants more realistic view of NZ asset risk.

text.p: Reserve Bank of New Zealand governor Don Brash on Monday called for a more realistic understanding of the risks of investing in New Zealand dollar assets.
"Clearly, one direct way of reducing the risk inherent in the present situation would be to ensure that further fiscal stimulus is not added in the process of coalition forming," Brash said.

Nationalist New Zealand First, which holds the balance of power, is negotiating separately with the caretaker National party government and the main opposition Labour party over the shape of the new government.
